# Bad Iterators Examples
# Demonstrates ITER-001, ITER-002, ITER-003, and ITER-004

namespace = iterators_bad

# ERROR ITER-001: Effect inside any_ block
iterators_bad.0001 = {
	type = character_event
	title = iterators_bad.0001.t
	desc = iterators_bad.0001.desc
	theme = diplomacy

	left_portrait = root

	trigger = {
		any_vassal = {
			is_adult = yes
			add_gold = 100 # ERROR ITER-001: 'add_gold' is an effect inside trigger iterator any_vassal
			# Should use: every_vassal for effects
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = iterators_bad.0001.a
	}
}

# ERROR ITER-002: Only triggers in every_ block
iterators_bad.0002 = {
	type = character_event
	title = iterators_bad.0002.t
	desc = iterators_bad.0002.desc
	theme = stewardship

	left_portrait = root

	immediate = {
		every_vassal = {
			limit = {
				is_adult = yes
			}
			is_ruler = yes # ERROR ITER-002: Trigger inside effect iterator every_vassal
			is_alive = yes # ERROR ITER-002: Another trigger, no effects present
			# Should use: any_vassal for trigger evaluation, or add effects
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = iterators_bad.0002.a
	}
}

# ERROR ITER-003: ordered_ missing order_by
iterators_bad.0003 = {
	type = character_event
	title = iterators_bad.0003.t
	desc = iterators_bad.0003.desc
	theme = martial

	left_portrait = root

	immediate = {
		ordered_vassal = {
			# ERROR ITER-003: Missing required 'order_by' field
			# Should have: order_by = martial
			limit = {
				is_adult = yes
			}
			max = 3
			add_prestige = 100
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = iterators_bad.0003.a
	}
}

# ERROR ITER-004: ordered_ missing position and max
iterators_bad.0004 = {
	type = character_event
	title = iterators_bad.0004.t
	desc = iterators_bad.0004.desc
	theme = intrigue

	left_portrait = root

	immediate = {
		ordered_vassal = {
			order_by = intrigue
			# ERROR ITER-004: No 'position' or 'max' field
			# Should have: max = 5 or position = 0
			limit = {
				is_adult = yes
			}
			add_gold = 100
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = iterators_bad.0004.a
	}
}

# Multiple errors combined
iterators_bad.0005 = {
	type = character_event
	title = iterators_bad.0005.t
	desc = iterators_bad.0005.desc
	theme = learning

	left_portrait = root

	trigger = {
		any_vassal = {
			is_adult = yes
			add_prestige = 50 # ERROR ITER-001: Effect in trigger iterator
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		every_vassal = {
			limit = {
				is_adult = yes
			}
			is_ruler = yes # ERROR ITER-002: Only triggers in effect iterator
		}

		ordered_vassal = {
			# ERROR ITER-003: Missing order_by
			# ERROR ITER-004: Missing position and max
			limit = {
				is_alive = yes
			}
			add_gold = 100
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = iterators_bad.0005.a
	}
}

# Edge case: Effect in any_ nested inside trigger block
iterators_bad.0006 = {
	type = character_event
	title = iterators_bad.0006.t
	desc = iterators_bad.0006.desc
	theme = diplomacy

	left_portrait = root

	trigger = {
		any_child = {
			is_adult = yes
			any_vassal = {
				is_alive = yes
				remove_trait = craven # ERROR ITER-001: Effect in nested trigger iterator
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = iterators_bad.0006.a
	}
}

# Edge case: ordered_ with order_by but nothing else useful
iterators_bad.0007 = {
	type = character_event
	title = iterators_bad.0007.t
	desc = iterators_bad.0007.desc
	theme = stewardship

	left_portrait = root

	immediate = {
		ordered_courtier = {
			order_by = stewardship
			# ERROR ITER-004: Has order_by but no position or max
			# Should have: max = 5 or position = 0 to limit iteration
			add_gold = 50
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = iterators_bad.0007.a
	}
}

# Edge case: every_ with limit triggers only (no body effects)
iterators_bad.0008 = {
	type = character_event
	title = iterators_bad.0008.t
	desc = iterators_bad.0008.desc
	theme = martial

	left_portrait = root

	immediate = {
		every_held_title = {
			limit = {
				tier >= tier_duchy
			}
			# ERROR ITER-002: No effects after limit — did you mean any_held_title?
			# Should use: any_held_title for evaluation, or add effects here
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = iterators_bad.0008.a
	}
}
